recipe.visualDefinition: A centered medium-shot portrait of a female figure with arms raised behind her head, set against a deep blue vignetted background. The composition features high-contrast white clothing and delicate, wide-tracked typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: The white textured knitwear acts as a high-key anchor against the dark blue void.
The triangular silhouette formed by the raised arms frames the face centrally.
The horizontal text block balances the verticality of the subject's torso.
The warm skin tones provide a complementary color contrast to the cool blue backdrop.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium shot, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white knit sweater in the lower half of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright white torso, moves up to the face, then follows the arms outward to the text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant blue space in the upper corners and around the waist to emphasize the silhouette.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm Peach/Tan (Skin tones and hair highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the subject's clothing and the background; low saturation in the shadows of the blue gradient.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cool blues and warm neutrals

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of decorative script and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary line uses a high-contrast, slanted copperplate-style script
Secondary line uses a clean, monolinear geometric sans-serif
Extreme letter spacing (tracking) applied to both lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Enlarged initial capitals for the script line
Uniform stroke weight for the sans-serif line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Script for personality paired with a clean sans-serif for legibility and modern balance.
graphicDevices: Vignetted background to focus on center

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the elegant, high-contrast flourished script style.
Provides the clean, geometric sans-serif contrast for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with 1970s feathered blonde hair, wearing a white textured knit sweater, arms raised behind her head, centered against a deep blue radial gradient background with soft vignetting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of white text at the top center. The first line should be a flourished copperplate script with very wide tracking. The second line should be a geometric sans-serif in title case, also with wide tracking, positioned closely beneath the first.

verificationChecks: Is the background a smooth blue gradient?
Is the text white and centered at the top?
Is the tracking on the text wide enough to span most of the frame width?
Is the subject's pose symmetrical with raised arms?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth color transitions in the blue background.
Ensure the white sweater doesn't lose detail in highlights.
Verify the script text is legible despite the wide tracking.
Confirm the subject's pose creates a clear triangular frame for the face.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait subject + Raised arms pose + White knitwear + Blue radial gradient background + Top-aligned wide-tracked script/sans-serif pairing.
